title: Appeals court upholds injunction against oil pipeline repairs - even though repairs are complete - Whatfinger News Quick Hits
text:
The oil has been flowing for months off the coast of Santa Barbara. So has the litigation.
(CN) — A California appeals court on Wednesday affirmed a trial court’s order granting a preliminary injunction against an oil drilling company that would, in theory, prevent the company from repairing its oil pipeline. But the pipeline repairs have already been completed, and oil has been flowing for months, thanks to an intervention by the Trump administration.
Additional Reads
Read Full Article: https://www.courthousenews.com/appeals-court-upholds-injunction-against-oil-pipeline-repairs-even-though-repairs-are-complete/
